propositions: Core implements exactly five CAS retry cycles plus one conditional terminal push; successful push before exhaustion skips the terminal push, and fifth rejection with clean merge triggers exactly one sixth push.
Strict delivery mode raises catchable PushDeliveryError with pinned stable reasons and git detail; best-effort mode (default) remains unchanged for all pre-existing callers.

The private Python module adapter (python -m rebar._store.push push --strict) translates PushDeliveryError into stderr and nonzero exit; strict failure writes no ticket event and emits no BRIDGE_ALERT.

All legacy callers (event append, batch append, import, close, delete, compact, claim) omit strict or reach core with strict=False, preserving best-effort behavior and inheritance of the corrected retry budget.

Policy declines and transport failures are distinguished by stable reasons; strict errors carry underlying git/config detail and unpushed-commit count without modifying persisted schema or ticket events.
